facts.fact: The ICT Authority's strategic plan for 2024 to 2027 states that the County Governments have not prioritised ICT investments in their development planning and have continued to rely on national government initiatives to support their connectivity; it gives no date for this, so its published date is used.

The plan also lists the lack of a legal framework for standardising county government ICT investments as a threat, and says devolution lets county governments widen ICT services subject to their own prioritisation and budgeting; neither states a connection.
